source.citation: Maynard SA, Rostaing P, Schaefer N, et al. eLife 10:e74441 (2021).

acquisition.coordinateScope: raw XY numeric values in the MAT file; physical unit, origin, axis orientation, and drift-correction state are not established by the local source README
acquisition.recordInterpretation: localization detections, not unique receptor molecules or segmented structures
acquisition.frameInterpretation: source frame index; frame interval and elapsed-time calibration are not established

matrix.sourceStorageOrder: MATLAB column-major; each output record preserves one source matrix column

limits: No nanometre or micrometre scale is assigned to the raw X/Y values.
No drift correction, origin, handedness, registration or 3D depth is inferred.
Detections are not counted as unique receptor molecules because blinking and conversion affect detection counts.
The source count table reports two clusters and is not an exhaustive partition or an object-level crosswalk for these detections.
AQ848 PALM tissue is not the separate BP057 EM acquisition, a selected atlas cell, or a named interneuron.
